title: Is Graph Bipartite?
constraints: Every neighbor is a valid vertex index.
The graph is undirected: every edge is listed in both directions.
There are no self-loops or duplicate neighbors.
inputFormat: Implement isBipartite(graph), where graph[v] lists the neighbors of vertex v in an undirected graph.
outputFormat: true if all vertices can be assigned to two groups such that every edge connects different groups; otherwise false. Check every connected component.

visuals.caption: The four-cycle is bipartite. An odd cycle cannot be colored with two colors without a conflict.
